title: VulnzxScanX
description: Multi-interface vulnerability scanner aggregator using Nmap. Supports CLI, Web Dashboard, and GUI with IP rotation via Tor.
details: Automates network reconnaissance with Nmap script engine. Aggregates results across interfaces. Tor integration for IP rotation and anonymity during scans.

title: Identity-AI
description: Behavioral threat detection system that analyzes authentication logs to detect suspicious activity using statistical baselining.
details: Statistical baselining of user authentication patterns. Anomaly scoring with Z-score and IQR methods. Real-time alert generation for deviations from normal behavior.

title: ML CTF Challenges
description: AI/ML security CTF challenges covering model attacks, LLM exploitation, and AI Agent exploitation techniques.
details: Hands-on challenges for adversarial ML: model extraction, prompt injection, data poisoning, evasion attacks. Designed for red teamers entering AI security.

title: Claude-Red
description: Curated library of offensive security skills designed for the Claude skills system. Expert-level methodology for security testing.
details: Structured skill definitions for Claude covering reconnaissance, exploitation, privilege escalation, and lateral movement. Maps to MITRE ATT&CK framework.

title: neo-profile-scribe
description: Profile generation tool built with React, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS.
details: Dynamic portfolio generator with template engine. Exports static HTML from JSON data. Responsive design with dark/light themes.

title: face-recognition-app
description: Face recognition application using machine learning.
details: Real-time face detection and recognition using OpenCV and dlib. Embedding-based matching with configurable confidence thresholds.

title: India-Accelerator-OpenXAI-2025
description: OpenXAI accelerator project for AI research and development.
details: Open-source AI research initiative. Contributed to explainable AI frameworks and model interpretability tools for production systems.

title: Root-Access-2k26
